scraper.comments: Options: 'beautifulsoup' or 'selenium'. BeautifulSoup is faster, Selenium handles JavaScript better.

search.comments_categories: Leave empty [] to scrape all categories, or specify: ['Restaurants', 'Cafes', 'Medical']
search.comments_locations: Leave empty [] to scrape all locations, or specify: ['Sydney', 'Melbourne', 'Brisbane']

scraping.comments_max_pages: Maximum number of pages to scrape per category-location combination
scraping.comments_delay: Seconds to wait between requests (be respectful to server)
scraping.comments_delay_searches: Seconds to wait between different searches

selenium.comments_wait: Seconds to wait for elements to load

logging.comments_level: Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL
